question: Which of the following languages is NOT recognised in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhojpuri.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhojpuri** is an **Indo-Aryan language **spoken in the **Gangetic Plains of Northern India and also the Terai region of Nepal.**
 
• It is mainly spoken in the **western region of Bihar and the Poorvanchal** area of the state of **Uttar Pradesh (UP), India.**
 
• Nepal is a country that has one of the **national languages as Bhojpuri** and in India, the **states of Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Jharkhand are Bhojpuri-speaking states.**
 
• Aside from Nepal, Bhojpuri is an **acknowledged official language in Fiji too.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The languages mentioned in 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution serve as the official languages in India. 
 
• **22 official languages** have been referred to in the Indian Constitution.
 
• The** **Eighth Schedule to the Constitution** **comprises the following 22 languages: **Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Kashmiri, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Nepali, Oriya, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Sindhi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Bodo, Santhali, Maithili and Dogri.**
